05/19.04.2023 Learned counsel for the parties are present.

2. Learned counsel for the respondents has submitted that from the perusal of the writ petition, it appears that the main grievance of the petitioner is that the various provisions of law have not been followed in the matter of acquisition of land under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Re- Settlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Re- Settlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He submits that as per his instructions, all the procedure has been followed and he shall file a counter-affidavit by the next week.
The learned counsel has also referred to Annexure- 7 of the writ petition which is a notification under Section 11(1) which grants 60 days' time for raising objection.
The learned counsel submits that it was for the petitioner to raise any objection in terms of the said notice.

3. Post this case on 27.04.2023 in the supplementary cause-list.
4. The counter-affidavit should be filed by 25.04.2023.
